simple.meaning: מָעַל (mâʻal) appears 36 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, and 6 more, beginning at Leviticus 5:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, flock, offering, altar, faith.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָעַל (H4603) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מָעַל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מָעַל (mâʻal) / H4603 is tracked through Leviticus 5:15, Leviticus 5:21, Leviticus 26:40, Numbers 5:6. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H4603. maal מָעַל verb act unfaithfully, treacherously , a priestly word (P Ezra, Chronicles), chiefly late (Late Hebrew id., act unfaithfully ; Arabic whisper, backbite , perfidy, fraud ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular מָעַל Josh 22:20 4 t.; 3 feminine singular מָֽעֲלָה Leviticus 5:21; Num 5:12-13 t. Perfect; Imperfect יִמְעַל Prov 16:10 ; 2Chr 26:16 ; 3 feminine singular תִּמְעֹל Lev 5:15 ; Num 5:27 ; 3 masculine plural יִמְעֲלוּ Josh 7:1 , וַיִּמְעֲלוּ 1Chr 5:25 ; 2 masculine plural תִּמְעָ֑לוּ Neh 1:8 ; Infinitive construct לִמְעֹל , so read for HCT למסר Num 31:16 Thes Di; — act unfaithfully, treacherously , usually 1 מַ֫עַל מָעַל : a. absolute בַּחֵרֶם in the matter of the devoted thing (the sin of Achan) Josh 7:1 (JE), 22:20 (P), compare Lev 5:15 (P), 2Chr 36:14 ; Ezek 14:13 ; 15:8 ; 18:24 . b. wife against ( בְּ ) husband Num 5:12 , 27 (P; marital infidelity). c. elsewhere against ( בְּ ) God, Lev 26:40 (H), Leviticus 5:21; Num 5:6 ; 31:16 (?) Josh 22:16 , 31 (all P), 1Chr 10:13 ; 28:19 ; Ezek 17:20 ; 20:27 ; 39:26 ; Dan 9:7 . 2 usage without מַעַל (only late): a. פיו ימעל לא במשׁפט Prov 16:10 let not his (the king's) mouth act treacherously against justice (RV in judgment ). b. elsewhere against God, with בְּ , Deut 32:51 (P), 1Chr 5:25 ; 12:2 ; 26:22 ; 1Chron 30:7; Ezra 10:2 ; Neh 13:27 ; Ezek 39:23 ; without בְּ , 2Chr 26:18 ; 29:6 ; Ezra 10:10 ; Neh 1:8 ; בַּחֵרֶם 1Chr 2:7 .
